input.task: Send an enquiry from Ada Lovelace (ada@example.com) asking whether the Aurora lamp is dimmable, and report the reference number.

provenance: tc5-forms-submit under a11y-stripped, and the only case that can hold the mutation's submit shim honest. shop.html's form is JS-handled (`onsubmit="return doSearch(event)"`), so a shim built on `dispatchEvent(new Event('submit'))` looks correct there — it fires the inline handler. forms.html is a REAL POST form, and against it that shim submits nothing at all: no request, no server record, and l4-shop-a11y-stripped stays green while the mutation quietly damages every other fixture it touches. Watched red against that shim before it was replaced: failure:act, postcondition 'Enquiry received' never reached, and the server's record still {'name': None, 'email': None, 'message': None} — while l4-shop-a11y-stripped stayed green in the same run. The shim is now `form.requestSubmit()`, which fires the submit event AND performs the native submission. The pass condition is external ground truth — the server's own record at /fixtures/forms/state (verifier layer 2) — so a green here means the POST really landed, not that a postcondition looked right.

triage.note: M3 relocation, rung 2 (text tier): the submit control is a div under this mutation, so role+name finds nothing and `{text: 'Submit enquiry'}` clicks it. Also the only mutation coverage of TC5.
